title: Why so many musicians got hooked
summary: Idleness and easy availability; a neighbour dealer got him started.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, it's part of your story.
Yeah.
As it relates to the whole... For instance, with the addiction thing, you might be talking about yourself, but you're talking about a thing that was...
That happened.
That happened to so many people in that time.
That's a shame.
It is. But what do you think caused it other than the fact that, you know...
You wasn't doin' nothing... When you ain't doin' nothin'...
When you weren't working.
Yeah. When you ain't workin', you're wide open for anything.
But also it was so available.
Right. It was so available. And you didn't have to buy it. People would come by and give it to you.
In order to get you hooked.

Yeah, in order to get you started. The guy living right across the street from me used to come by and say, 'How you feel, Maggie?' I said, 'Well, I don't feel so good.' And he said, 'Well, come on, hang out with me,' and
McGhee (12/1) - 14

he'd give me a taste or something, I'd take a snort here or there. Next thing I know, I'd be feeling pretty fair. So this went down for I guess about a month or so. Every day he'd come by and tell me all... One day he came by and I told him I didn't feel so good. So he says, "Well, I know where I can get some for you." I said, "Uh-oh, this sounds like it anyway..." But I felt so bad that I had to have it, so I told him to go get it. He said he was going to get it, you know, but he really was the Man all the time. He just was egging me on to make me want to think that he wasn't doing it. But he was the cat that was peddling the shit and he got me hooked on all this stuff -- which was horrible.
But like I say, I went to Riker's Island and came off of that...
Then you cleaned up and...
Yeah. Then I came back out on the street and started working with Woody, then the cat hit me in the chops with my mouthpiece.
About how long did your chops bother you after that?
Oh, maybe two weeks. I couldn't play high notes for a while. But that's all right. We were playing at Basin Street East anyway.
